processing.edit: Only a fixed desktop crop/scale and selective vibrance/colour grade of the V9 450-frame eased film. Temporal order, 30fps and 15-second duration are unchanged.
processing.originalWatermark: Outside the fixed V10 desktop crop at every timestamp; already outside the existing V9 portrait crop. The original source and V9 film remain unchanged.
processing.mobileFraming: Preserved 720x1280 V9 portrait framing; no extra crop or zoom.
processing.gradingIntent: Selective vibrance in alternate mode strengthens previously muted vegetation and gold earth while reducing its effect as RGB colour spread increases. The inherited V9 warmth is retained; a small exposure/contrast refinement preserves cream architecture and neutral shadows. No second colorbalance pass, sky, sun or synthetic scene is introduced.
processing.interpolation: Inherited from V9; no second temporal interpolation is applied.
processing.motionBlur: None added. No transition blur or colour overlay is baked into the film.

limitations: Official archival source uploaded 28 January 2019; not evidence of current campus condition.
Original web compression and haze cannot be recovered into a clean camera master.
Motion interpolation may create small edge warps around moving foliage or fine architecture; it infers temporal frames rather than recovering original camera samples.
V10 re-encodes an already compressed V9 delivery film once; fixed crop enlarges existing detail rather than recovering new camera resolution.
